court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Veena D/O Prabhakr Ozarkar Alias Veena ... vs Shri. Deepak Madhukar Ozarkar And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Veena D/O Prabhakr Ozarkar Alias Veena, Plaintiff
parties.respondent_defendant: Shri. Deepak Madhukar Ozarkar And Anr, Defendants

facts_of_case: Petitioner is the daughter of one Prabhakar and Bindarkaur. She claims to be an illegitimate child born out of void marriage. The Petitioner's mother was working with said Prabhakar and there was a love affair between them. The Petitioner is challenging the legality and validity of orders passed by the trial court.

legal_principles.principle: A person cannot claim properties of their biological father as a legal heir solely on the basis of physical relationship between their mother and the father.
legal_principles.held: The Appellate Court held that performance of marriage, whether void or voidable is a condition precedent for a person to establish claim on the property left by his/her biological father.
cited_cases: Parayankandiyal Eravath Kanapravan Kalliani Amma (Smt) & Ors Vs. K. Devi & Ors, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The DNA report is a prima facie evidence that can be relied upon to establish the biological relationship between a person and their alleged father.
legal_principles.held: The Appellate Court accepted the said DNA reports at prima facie stage and held that the Petitioner is the daughter of Prabhakar.
cited_cases: Veena D/O Prabhakr Ozarkar Alias Veena ... vs Shri. Deepak Madhukar Ozarkar And Anr, (Year) X SCC Y

use_for_drafting: challenging an order in family court
